name: CPsyCoun
description: Using large language models (LLMs) to assist psychological counseling is a significant but challenging task at present. Attempts have been made on improving empathetic conversations or acting as effective assistants in the treatment with LLMs. However, the existing datasets lack consulting knowledge, resulting in LLMs lacking professional consulting competence.
reputation: A niche but timely benchmark for psychologically informed counseling dialogue, with growing interest due to the broader push to evaluate LLMs in mental-health support settings.
notes: Likely relies on subjective human judgment and may be sensitive to safety, empathy, and professional-ethics criteria; benchmark size and public adoption appear limited.
